reuse.why: Builds on the existing getWeekendAdjustedDay, which every caller (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) already uses, and replaces the private weekend solver instead of adding a parallel one.

duplication.why: The non-working-day test, the lookahead and the shift window are each defined once in shared/schedules.ts; only the pre-existing daily-skip filter is extended in place at its three sites rather than being merged.

placement.why: All rules live in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend logic; the server only passes config.holidays and calls the shared window helpers.

scope.why: Only the holiday field, its propagation and the shared helpers and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Named, commented helpers for the predicate and both search windows make the design easy to own, though the daily-skip filter is still written at three sites.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday and getWeekendAdjustedDay in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, with getDailyLookahead/getMaxShiftDays for the windows; all schedule paths call them.
